note: No zoning district layer published for Taylor County WV or its city Grafton. ArcGIS searches for zoning returned nothing for Taylor County. County building commission and Grafton city ordinance pages list no zoning map or GIS. National Zoning Atlas says about three quarters of WV jurisdictions have no zoning; county zoning records are held by the building department or clerk with no online layer found. The Taylor County assessor map card viewer and parcel GIS carry no zoning district layer.
